answer_1.quote: We began by considering all 578 papers published at the main SIGGEN venue(s): the International Natural Language Generation Conference (INLG) and the European Workshop on Natural Language Generation (ENLG), which were merged in 2016.

answer_4.quote: We screened the 578 papers looking for mention of a human evaluation, first by skimming for relevant section headings and then by searching in the PDFs for 'human', 'subject', and 'eval'.
answer_4.guideline: an experiment involving assessment of system outputs in terms of an explicitly or implicitly given quality criterion, either via (1) conscious assessment of outputs in terms of the criterion by evaluators (e.g. (dis)agreement with quality statement, direct and relative assessment, qualitative feedback); or (2) counts and other measurements of outputs and user interactions with them
